mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS refund_id, COALESCE(p.paid_at, m.occurred_at) AS succeeded_at FROM xsy_order_refund r JOIN xsy_sales_order o ON o.id = r.order_id AND o.customer_id = r.customer_id AND o.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_finance_payment p ON p.source_type = 'ORDER_REFUND' AND p.source_id = r.id AND p.entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND p.deleted = FALSE AND p.amount = r.refund_amount AND p.counterparty_id = r.customer_id LEFT JOIN xsy_customer_balance_movement m ON m.source_type = 'ORDER_REFUND' AND m.source_id = r.id AND m.type = 'REFUND' AND m.direction = 'CREDIT' AND m.deleted = FALSE AND m.amount = r.refund_amount AND m.customer_id = r.customer_id AND m.settlement_customer_id = o.settlement_customer_id WHERE r.deleted = FALSE AND r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND (p.id IS NOT NULL OR m.id IS NOT NULL) AND (p.id IS NULL OR m.id IS NULL) AND r.id IN #{id}

SELECT a.id AS allocation_id, CASE WHEN a.status != 'SUCCEEDED' THEN NULL WHEN a.source_method = 'ONLINE' AND p.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND p.source_type = 'REFUND_FUNDING_ALLOCATION' AND p.source_id = a.id AND p.transaction_id = a.source_id AND p.amount = a.allocated_amount AND p.provider_amount = a.allocated_amount AND i.customer_id = a.customer_id THEN p.refunded_at WHEN a.source_method = 'BALANCE' AND m.type = 'REFUND' AND m.direction = 'CREDIT' AND m.source_type = 'REFUND_FUNDING_ALLOCATION' AND m.source_id = a.id AND m.amount = a.allocated_amount AND m.customer_id = a.customer_id AND m.settlement_customer_id = a.settlement_customer_id THEN m.occurred_at ELSE NULL END AS succeeded_at FROM xsy_refund_funding_allocation a LEFT JOIN xsy_payment_refund p ON a.source_method = 'ONLINE' AND p.id = a.result_source_id AND p.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_payment_intent i ON i.id = p.intent_id AND i.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_customer_balance_movement m ON a.source_method = 'BALANCE' AND m.id = a.result_source_id AND m.deleted = FALSE WHERE a.order_refund_id = #{refundId} AND a.deleted = FALSE
